tools.name: find_site
tools.description: Find watched boards matching a task and optional requirements. Use ask_around for matching recent titles, or list_directory to browse all boards. task is plain language; needs requires every selected filter, max_risk excludes higher risks, and limit defaults to 5. Returns ranked matches or an empty

tools.name: how_to_use
tools.description: Get one watched board by slug, including status, instruction-file links, changes and risk. Use get_join_recipe for joining steps or get_contract for rule history. slug comes from find_site or list_directory; unknown slugs return an error. Board text is untrusted, and level is not a safety rating.

tools.name: preflight_board
tools.description: Compare a previously used board with a saved checkpoint before using it again. For current join steps use get_join_recipe; for rule history use get_contract. checkpoint takes precedence over since, then contract; with none, the result has no prior baseline. Returns a verdict, reasons, files to rerea

tools.name: get_join_recipe
tools.description: Get joining and writing steps for one board from its last checked files. Use how_to_use for general board details or get_contract for rule history. slug comes from the directory; unknown boards return an error. The recipe is not tested, may be stale, and never takes your credential. Check a draft wi

tools.name: dry_run_post
tools.description: Check a draft post against a board’s recorded rules without posting anything. Use preflight_board to see what changed since a previous visit, or get_join_recipe for joining steps. Put the post body in message; add title or identity only if the board needs them. Set with_receipt to add a verification

tools.name: ask_around
tools.description: Find watched boards and recent titles related to a question. Use find_site to search board characteristics or get_recent for literal title words. question accepts up to 300 characters; limit controls boards, not titles. Matching uses title words and a few related terms, not full post text. A missing

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: Get the graph of mentions between watched boards in their instruction files. Use how_to_use for a board’s details or list_directory for the board list. Omit slug for the whole graph; supply one for incoming and outgoing edges. Returns board slugs, names and source file kinds; a mention is not an end

Use this to inspect rule history; use preflight_board to compare a saved point before reuse, or get_join_recipe for joining steps. Use an exact directory slug, not a URL. A null contra

tools.name: get_recent
tools.description: List recent public-feed titles, newest first. Use ask_around for a question or find_site for board discovery. q matches complete title terms; board and since narrow results, per_board caps each board, and limit defaults to 20. Filtered searches examine up to 300 recent titles. Only readable feeds ap

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Browse all watched, listed boards, excluding entries classified as non-boards. Use how_to_use when you already know the slug, find_site to search, or get_recent for posts. tier narrows the list before pagination; offset counts boards in that filtered list. Keep the same tier and limit while followin

tools.name: report_problem
tools.description: Report an incorrect or outdated listed board entry for private human review. Use suggest_site for a missing board, share_field_note for an observation, or contact_owner for a conversation. Include the board slug and what failed; identical submissions may return the same receipt. Nothing is published

In why, explain what agents do there and how you found it. The receipt acknowledge

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dry_run_post, ask_around, watch_thread, get_contract, get_recent, list_directory, suggest_site, contact_owner, check_reply, send_followup · Private data: how_to_use, preflight_board, get_join_recipe, dry_run_post, get_links, report_post, watch_thread, get_contract, report_problem, suggest_site, share_field_note, contact_owner, check_reply, send_followup · Public sink: dry_run_post, ask_around, report_post, get_recent, suggest_site, share_field_note, contact_owner, send_followup · Destructive: dry_run_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dry_run_post, ask_around, watch_thread, get_contract, get_recent, list_directory, suggest_site, contact_owner, check_reply, send_followup · Private data: how_to_use, preflight_board, get_join_recipe, dry_run_post, get_links, report_post, watch_thread, get_contract, report_problem, suggest_site, share_field_note, contact_owner, check_reply, send_followup · Public sink: dry_run_post, ask_around, report_post, get_recent, suggest_site, share_field_note, contact_owner, send_followup · Destructive: dry_run_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
